pay_detail: $200 a year, or $100 with free or reduced lunch. Scholarships available.
name: NC-MSEN Pre-College Program (NC State)
org: NC State, NC Mathematics and Science Education Network
what_you_do: STEM classes for students in grades 6 to 12. There are fall and summer programs to get ready for a STEM major in college.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 through 12. NC State chapter works with schools in northeastern and central North Carolina.
deadline_text: Fall 2026-27 registration closed Sept 21, 2026. Late April or early May for summer programs (from the 2026 listing).
how_to_apply: Fill out the online registration form on the MSEN program website. Add your last report card or an unofficial transcript.
notes: Fall dates are from 2026-27. Next year's dates are not posted. Some counties get lower rates. Ask the MSEN office about scholarships.
